## The recordings

- **ween2008-01-26** (recommended): source not stated; 35 songs; 142 min [1]
- **ween2008-01-26.ca11**: source not stated; 33 songs; 137 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [2]. Said about its sound: Reviewer judges this recording to be very good [7]

## Around the show

## Tapers and lineage

- **ween2008-01-26**: taped by Jadedphan; transferred by Jadedphan; source: FOB: Schoeps Mk4 (ortf) > KC5 > CMC6 > Apogee AD1000 > Sony D8 @ 48kHz, 16 bit [1]. Also: Resampled and remastered in Vegas 8.0 pro; transferred via Tascam DA-30, coax, M-Audio 24/96 into Sound Forge 9.0, by Jadedphan [1]
- **ween2008-01-26.ca11**: taped by Chris King; transferred by Chris King; source: M-audio16/44/ Pre Amp:Church-Audio ST-9100 stereo microphone preamp Mics Church-Audio STC-11 stereo cardioid microphone [2]
- **ween2008-01-26.mbho**: taped by Jason Westbrook; transferred by Jason Westbrook; source: MBHO 603's > KA200n (Card Caps) > Audio Magic XLRs > Busman mod PMD 660 [3]. Also: Jason Westbrook taped with MBHO 603 mics, Audio Magic cables, and a modified PMD 660, then transferred via USB and split tracks to FLAC [3]
